title: VIRTUAL INTAKE SPECIALIST & DATA COORDINATOR
description:
Position: Virtual Intake Specialist / Receptionist

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Reports to: Senior Paralegal

Firm Focus: United States Family-Based Immigration & Citizenship



I. ROLE PURPOSE



The Virtual Intake Specialist serves as the firm’s "Manager of First Impressions." You are the primary point of contact for all potential and existing clients. Your goal is to provide a warm, empathetic, and professional experience while ensuring all data is captured accurately in our systems to facilitate rapid case production and maintain the firm's reputation for excellence.



II. WORKING HOURS



Shift: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST).



Alignment: This role requires full synchronization with U.S. business hours to provide real-time support to clients and the legal team.



III. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Strategic Gatekeeping & Reception

Professional Greeting: Respond to all incoming telephone calls and inquiries promptly to build immediate trust.



Standardized Screening: Use the firm's standardized questionnaires to screen leads for eligibility and "fit" before scheduling them with the Senior Paralegal or Attorney.



Relationship Management: Maintain tact, clarity, and warmth in every interaction, ensuring clients feel their concerns are understood and respected.



2. Data Integrity & Workflow Automation

Standardized Intake: Guide new clients through the Case Management Software digital questionnaires to ensure a "single source of truth" for all biographical data.



Case Initiation: Prepare initial digital file folders and ensure all core documents (passports, birth certificates, etc.) are uploaded and named according to firm standards.



System Maintenance: Update case notes and status fields in the Case Management Software immediately following any client interaction to ensure real-time accuracy for the legal team.



3. Client Care & Responsiveness

Proactive Follow-ups: Use automated tools and direct outreach to "push" clients to complete their document checklists within the firm's required onboarding window.



Expectation Management: Provide clients with a clear summary of the firm's process so they understand their responsibilities and the next steps in their legal journey.



IV. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English skills; ability to convey complex information clearly without using unnecessary "legalese."



Technology Proficiency: High level of comfort with Case Management Software, document automation tools, and VoIP phone systems.



Attention to Detail: Absolute accuracy in data entry; understanding that a single misspelling or date error can have significant legal consequences.



Ethics & Confidentiality: Strict adherence to client confidentiality protocols and a clear understanding that you cannot provide legal advice or interpret the law.



V. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Connectivity: Reliable high-speed internet connection; must have a secured mobile hotspot and power station available as a back-up.



Security: Must follow the firm’s Secure Password Policy and use an approved password manager.



Environment: A quiet, private professional workspace suitable for handling confidential client phone calls.



VI. FIRM CULTURE (THE CARE FRAMEWORK)



We are a high-performance firm that values:



Consistency: Working from the same playbook every time to ensure quality.



Agility: Finding opportunities to follow through and move cases forward immediately.



Responsiveness: Prioritizing the client's experience and peace of mind.



Efficiency: Leveraging technology to produce extraordinary quality with less manual effort.

title: Video Editor
description:
Counter Culture Productions is a boutique cinematic content studio specializing in short-form brand storytelling for regional and national clients. We produce commercials, social media reels, and advertising content that earns attention — not just fills a feed. We're looking for an editor who understands that every cut is a decision about meaning, not just timing.



You're not waiting to be told what the story is. You watch the footage, you find it. You have a developed sense of narrative arc — you know where tension lives, where the release needs to happen, and how to build a sequence that carries a viewer from curiosity to conviction without them knowing why they're hooked. You've watched enough great work — film, documentary, commercial — that pacing is intuitive to you. You don't just assemble clips. You build an experience.



Take raw footage from cinematic brand shoots and shape it into polished short-form content (60 sec) with minimal direction.



Develop and execute a narrative arc independently — rough cut to final with a clear editorial point of view.



Build pacing that serves the brand's emotional tone: sometimes kinetic, sometimes slow and deliberate, always intentional.



Color grade or work alongside a colorist to maintain visual consistency and cinematic feel.



Cut to music with a strong sense of rhythm and breath — not just on the beat.



Integrate AI-assisted tools (upscaling, audio cleanup, background generation, motion tracking, etc.) where they improve the work, not just the workflow.



Deliver client-ready 4K exports optimized for web, broadcast, and social formats.



Occasionally concept alongside the director in pre-production to flag editorial opportunities in the shot list.

title: $10/hour: Short-Form Video Editor + Content Scheduler (TikTok/Reels)
description:
Hi, I'm Andrew. I run two e-commerce brands and a personal channel. Yesterday alone, one video I created hit 2M+ views on IG, and I'm looking for a coachable long-term video editor to keep the virality spree going. You'll be directly tasked with creating content for brands with a combined 30,000+ followers and an algorithm that's currently on fire. You will be making a real impact.



The deal:

- $10 USD/hour via Hubstaff, growing as the role grows

- Paid every 2 weeks via Wise, on time

- Pro-rated 13th month bonus every December

- Long-term role with growing hours and responsibilities

- Paid 2-week trial period before formal long-term hiring



The role starts at 10 hrs/week. It will grow toward full-time as we continue to scale and I trust you more and more.



I keep my people: I have another VA who's been with me for over a year. She started at 30 minutes a week and now works 20-30 hours a week with multiple raises along the way. When I say long-term and growing, I mean it.



Schedule: Flexible on when you work. What matters is the posting calendar: videos edited, scheduled, and live on time, every day.



~80% short-form content, ~10% long-form content, ~10% scheduling said content



To be clear: short-form IS this role. If you're elite at short-form and just decent at long-form, you're exactly who I'm looking for. If long-form explainers are your specialty, this isn't your job.



What you'll do:

- Edit short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) for my brands: hooks, captions, pacing, sound

- Main work entails working with AI-generated video clips (Higgsfield) and making viral short-form content: assembling, polishing, and making them feel native to the platform

- Schedule and publish all content via Metricool across multiple accounts

- Follow and improve our content SOPs (hook formulas, caption styles, what's working)

- Secondary task: edit my personal channel. 5-10 minute talking-head videos plus shorts, 1-2 per week, simple clean style

- Communicate with me daily via WhatsApp (async, I don't expect instant replies)

- Take on new responsibilities as the business grows



Hard skills required (short-form specific):

- Elite short-form editing in CapCut: hooks that stop the scroll in under 1 second, pacing that holds retention, captions and sound that feel native to the platform

- You can look at a video's first 3 seconds and tell me why it will or won't get pushed by the algorithm

- A track record editing for TikTok/Reels/Shorts specifically. Show me, don't tell me.

- You watch short-form daily and know the difference between an amazing video, a good one, and a bad one

- Comfortable with Metricool (or willing to learn quickly)

- Good written English, reliable internet, and a machine that can handle editing



Soft skills required:



- Highly coachable: I'll teach you our brand styles, hook formulas, and workflows. Learn fast and ask good questions.

- Detail-oriented: a typo in a caption or a video posted to the wrong account costs real money

- Consistent: this role lives and dies on the posting schedule

- Has taste: you should have opinions about why a video is boring and how to fix it



How to apply: No skills test, no essay. Just message me the link to one Loom video, covering these things. 5 minutes max or you will be disqualified. Being concise is crucial in this role, refilm if needed:



- About yourself. Your short-form editing experience and why you fit this role

- One thing that actually makes you you (a weird hobby, a strong opinion, your worst cooking disaster, anything but "I'm passionate about editing")

- Screen-share 1-2 short-form videos you've edited that performed well (TikTok/Reels/Shorts, NOT long-form explainers, those will be ignored) and walk me through: why that hook, why that cut, what you'd change now. Show me the timeline. If you've run accounts with big view counts, drop those links too.

- Please attach your portfolio via Google Drive if you have it. If not OK. Loom is the most important part.



One real ask: don't run this through ChatGPT and read it off a script. I can tell instantly, it's painfully obvious, and it looks exactly like every other application. I'd genuinely rather watch you fumble through a real answer than nail a robotic one. Be a person, get creative, go off-script. There are no rules here, I just want it from the heart. I will watch every single Loom. Impress me, be different, and be creative!

We need a results-obsessed Ads Manager VA who lives inside Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads daily. Your job is simple to define and hard to execute: bring in qualified leads for construction and landscaping projects in the Houston, TX market at a cost we can scale. You will own ad strategy, creative testing, budget optimization, and weekly reporting. You report directly to the CEO. Your performance is measured in leads and cost-per-lead — nothing else.

Build, launch, and manage paid ad campaigns on Meta 
/Instagram) and Google (Search, LSA, Display) targeting Houston-area homeowners and commercial property managers

Own the full funnel: ad creative direction, copy, audience targeting, landing page alignment, and lead follow-up handoff to GHL

Run structured A/B tests on creative, copy, and audiences — document what works and what does not, and act on it fast

Manage daily budgets and bids — scale what converts, kill what does not, no emotional attachment to ads that are not performing

Maintain clean campaign structure: proper naming conventions, UTM tagging, conversion tracking, and pixel/tag setup

Connect ad leads directly into GoHighLevel (GHL) pipeline — ensure every lead hits the CRM instantly and triggers the right automation

Produce weekly performance reports with the numbers that matter: spend, impressions, clicks, CPL, conversion rate, booked jobs. No vanity metrics.

Stay current on Meta and Google algorithm changes, creative trends, and what is working in the home services/construction space specifically

Proactively flag budget waste, audience fatigue, and creative burnout before they tank performance





WHAT YOU MUST KNOW — NON-NEGOTIABLE

Do not apply if you do not have real, proven experience with ALL of the following:



Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager — campaign build, audience creation (custom, lookalike, interest), creative testing, pixel events, CAPI setup

Google Ads — Search campaigns, Local Services Ads (LSA), conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager

Conversion tracking — pixel events, GTM, GA4 integration. If you cannot set up a lead event from scratch, do not apply.

GoHighLevel (GHL) — you must know how to connect ad leads into GHL pipelines. Bonus if you can build the automation on your end too.

Basic Canva or Adobe — enough to resize, adapt, or direct ad creatives without waiting on a designer for every iteration

Google Sheets / Data Studio / Looker Studio — for building and maintaining performance dashboards

Excellent written English — you will write ad copy. It must be punchy, local, and conversion-focused.





NICE TO HAVE



Experience running ads specifically for construction, home services, roofing, landscaping, or trades

Familiarity with Local Services Ads (LSA) and Google Guarantee badge process

Experience with reputation management (Google reviews, GMB) as part of a local lead gen strategy

Knowledge of retargeting strategies for longer sales cycles (construction projects are not impulse buys)

Experience with video ad editing or direction for short-form creative (Reels, YouTube pre-roll)



HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS IN FULL

Generic applications get deleted. You must include ALL of the following:



A Loom video (2–4 minutes) walking us through a real ad campaign you managed — show us inside Ads Manager. Show us results. CPL, spend, leads generated. If you cannot show real numbers, show us your campaign structure and explain your decisions. Live screen share only, no slideshows.

A written answer to this question: A Meta campaign for a Houston landscaping company has been running for 14 days. Spend is $400. CPL is $180. The client's target CPL is $75. What do you look at first and what do you change?

Your resume listing every ad platform, tool, and niche you have worked in — be specific.

Start your message with the words: LEADS NOT LIKES — so we know you read every word of this.

title: Remote Bookkeeper / Bookkeeping Assistant — QuickBooks Online (long-term)
description:
REMOTE BOOKKEEPER / BOOKKEEPING ASSISTANT — Functional Nutriments (Team Dog)



THE SHORT VERSION

We're a small group of U.S.-based, dog-focused companies looking for a sharp, dependable bookkeeper to work alongside our senior bookkeeper of nearly ten years. You'll own the day-to-day transactional work in QuickBooks Online across four related entities, so she can focus on the close, the reconciliations, and the judgment calls. This is a long-term, fully remote role for someone who chose accounting on purpose and takes quiet pride in books that tie out to the penny.



WHO WE ARE

Functional Nutriments makes science-backed supplements for dogs. We're part of a small family of related businesses: a dog supplement company, an independent dog-health information site, a podcast network for dog lovers, and a publishing imprint.



Our people (we think of ourselves as "Team Dog") are all fully remote professionals who live across several countries and time zones. We've operated this way for over twenty years. We're real and findable. (You're encouraged to look us up.) We treat the people who work with us like long-term partners. Some have been here for over a decade. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO



*  Categorize bank and credit-card feed transactions in QuickBooks Online, correctly and consistently

*  Enter accounts-payable bills and accounts-receivable invoices

*  Pull monthly revenue reports from Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, and PayPal and prep them for reconciliation

*  Vendor and W-9 administration, receipt collection, and document filing

*  Reconciliation prep and running reports for the senior bookkeeper's review

*  Flag anything that looks off — and ask before you guess



You will not be alone. A senior bookkeeper reviews the work and there's a clear escalation path. We want someone who can grow into more over time.



WHAT WE GENUINELY NEED 

    (please read this part >>>)

The single most important thing: you actually understand double-entry bookkeeping, not just the software. You know why undeposited funds exists, what a prepaid expense is and how it amortizes, why a refund doesn't go to the same account as a sale, and what to do when a deposit has no matching invoice. If a step exists, you understand why it exists. We'll happily teach you our books; we can't teach you bookkeeping itself.



Required:



*  Solid working grasp of double-entry fundamentals (accrual basis, debits/credits, accruals, prepaids, the matching principle)

*  At least 2 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including real QuickBooks Online work where you have owned the monthly books or close for at least one business (not just isolated data entry)

*  Strong, clear written English — you'll communicate mostly in writing but video calls are a real thing within Team Dog

*  Real attention to detail and the discipline to leave a clean audit trail

*  Reliability and good async communication: you do what you say, and you flag problems early

*  A quiet home work setup and stable internet and power



Nice to have (not required):



*  E-commerce bookkeeping experience (Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, PayPal, Wise)

*  Experience with multiple entities or intercompany transactions

*  QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification



THE DETAILS



*  Long-term independent contractor, fully remote

*  About 20 hours/week to start, with genuine room to grow toward full-time

*  USD$500-$700/month ($6 to $8/hour) depending on experience, with room to grow; paid twice per month via Wise

*  Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. Pacific/Hawaii hours for monthly close



HOW TO APPLY — AND HOW WE HIRE

We keep this simple and human:



1.  Apply here with your resume and a few sentences about your bookkeeping experience and why this role fits you. Include the word "ledger" in your note so we know you read the full post. Bonus points if you tell us about a special dog in your life.



2.  A short online skills screen (about 20 minutes, free). If your note and background look like a fit, we'll send you a personal message with a link to a quick, auto-graded screen covering bookkeeping fundamentals and QuickBooks — with a welcome video from our founder, so you know exactly who you're dealing with.



3.  A paid working interview. Our strongest candidates do a short, paid working session with us. PLUS you'll be compensated for your time as we walk through a real-world scenario and hear how you think.



A real company, a real person on the other end, and we pay you for the practical stage. We're hiring one person and we intend to keep them for years. If that's the role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a part-time position to start (20 hours per week), with the potential to grow as the working relationship develops.



What You Will Be Doing



• Managing client communication at pre-start stage —
s, follow-ups, and keeping homeowners informed

• Setting up and organising jobs in Buildxact before work begins

• Handling and organising incoming documents — consents, invoices, variation orders, delivery dockets, contracts, and more

• Proactively chasing outstanding documents, approvals, engineer reports, and supplier confirmations

• Back-costing through Buildxact — processing invoices, purchase orders, and tracking job costs



What We Are Looking For



• Background in construction administration or project coordination — experience in any market is welcome

• Buildxact experience is a strong advantage — if you do not have it, you must be quick to learn

• Available to work 20 hours per week during New Zealand business hours (NZT/NZST) — this role requires regular communication with clients, suppliers, councils, subcontractors, and the director throughout the day

• Excellent English communication skills — both written and verbal. This role requires regular communication with clients, engineers, councils, suppliers, and subcontractors via
, phone, video calls, online meetings, and messaging platforms. You must be confident following up on outstanding matters, coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and representing the business professionally at all times

• Strong attention to detail, especially when handling documents and job costing

• Someone who is genuinely proactive — you do not wait to be told, you get ahead of it



You Are the Right Fit If You Are



• Self-managing and comfortable working fully remotely with minimal supervision

• Calm and professional under pressure

• Adaptable — you are not the type who needs everything perfectly set up before you can start

• A natural communicator who keeps people updated without being asked

• Willing to learn NZ construction terminology and processes — this is a must

• Open to adapting from traditional Filipino corporate practices to a New Zealand work environment — this includes being comfortable with direct communication, a low-hierarchy workplace, less office politics, and a stronger focus on ownership, collaboration, and results



Training & Support



You will not be thrown in the deep end.



Find A Joyce will personally support your onboarding, including construction administration processes, council documentation, and back-costing, so you can hit the ground running with confidence. We also provide ongoing upskilling, training, and mentorship to help you grow your knowledge, develop your skills, and succeed in the role long-term.

title: Short-Form Producer: Own Reels/TikTok/Shorts. Ship 2–3/Day. Grow What Works, Kill What Doesn’t.
description:
Own our short?form content. Build a local brand that actually converts.



We’re hiring a full?time Content Producer & Strategist to join the team behind Ryan Lermitte and Umbrella Property Services- a fast?growing, values?driven brand based in Vancouver, Canada.



Across our two main Instagram profiles we average ~175,000 views per month, and over 225,000 monthly views across all platforms combined. Your job is to turn that attention into more reach, more saves/shares, and more inbound leads- by shipping a high volume of smart, on?brand content.



You won’t be out filming all day.



We already have a deep media library (photos, videos, before/afters, ongoing field uploads). Your job is to turn that raw material into a consistent stream of posts that perform – and to get faster and better over time.



If you love short?form content, have a sharp creative eye, and want a high?rep, high?feedback role where you’re judged on volume, performance, and improvement, this is for you.



What You’ll Do

- Ship content daily.

- Using our existing footage and photos, you will plan, edit, and publish, at minimum, every 28 days:

   >>> 40 Shorts/Reels (20–35s, 9:16, captions, text?first opening)

   >>> 12 Carousels

   >>> 12 Static image posts

   >>> 28 Story sets (each set ?3 tiles; at least 50% with a link or reply prompt)

- Maintain a daily minimum of at least one published piece of content.

- These are the floor expectations for a full?time role, not the ceiling. If you can hit them faster, we’ll use the remaining time to test more ideas and push performance.



Edit and design fast.

- Turn raw clips and photos into clean, on?brand content using templates, our STUDS media library, and AI tools.

- Craft sharp hooks, strong first frames, and scroll?stopping covers.



Track and improve.

- Log your work in our content dashboard.

- Review performance weekly and help choose which hooks and formats we double down on.



Engage with the community.

- Spend ~30 minutes/day engaging with comments, DMs, and local Vancouver accounts following our engagement SOP.



Run the system.

- Follow our content workflow.

- Keep folders, names, and trackers updated so anyone can follow your trail.



Who You Are

- You’ve grown social accounts before and can show numbers (views, saves, subs, followers, etc.).

- You understand short?form: hooks, pacing, retention, packaging.

- You’re comfortable being measured on:

    >>> Output (how much you ship),

    >>> Performance (watch time, saves/shares, leads), and

    >>> Efficiency (time per asset).

- You like finding ways to do the same quality work faster, then using that time to test more ideas.

- You’re coachable: feedback is fuel, not an attack.

- You think in systems: templates, checklists, and libraries, not chaos.

- You have 1+ years of content creation experience and a portfolio.

- You have a solid editing setup (fast internet, capable computer, second monitor, etc.).

- Bonus: you’re fluent with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut templates, Runway, etc.



Results You’ll Drive

- Hit our 28?day volume gate consistently.

- Grow monthly views beyond our current ~200,000+ across platforms.

- Improve average watch time and completion on Reels.

- Increase saves+shares per 1,000 impressions.

- Help generate inbound, content?sourced inquiries.

- Keep the content calendar tight and the library organized.



Tools You’ll Use

- CapCut

- Canva / Hootsuite

- Google Workspace, Slack

- AI tools for scripting, ideation, and analysis (ChatGPT, etc.)



Location & Compensation

- Remote

- Full?time contractor (40 hours/week)

- Base + performance?based bonus tied to content performance and consistency (discussed in detail in later stages).

- Initial 90?day evaluation period with clear targets and feedback.



Why Join Us

- Umbrella Property Services is a values?driven company built on Simplicity, Teamwork, Adventure, Results, and Sustainability.

- We believe in:

   >>> Clear expectations

   >>> High output

   >>> Honest feedback

   >>> Building systems that scale



We already average ~175,000 views/month on Instagram and 200,000+ across platforms. If you want a high?rep role where you can get very good, very fast – and you see minimums as a floor, not a ceiling – we want to talk. 



Our Hiring Process

- Complete this application form: 

- Portfolio review + short video

- Test tasks (hooks + audits)

- Paid trial sprint (1–3 days) with time?logging

- Final interview

title: Sales Support/ Project Coordinator
description:
THE ROLE

You are the person who makes sure no lead dies in the pipeline and no estimate gets delayed because the CEO is stretched thin. You sit between the lead coming in and the contract getting signed, and you own that middle. You are not closing deals — that is the CEO's job. But you are doing everything that makes it possible for the CEO to show up to that close prepared, on time, and with a polished proposal already built.

This role requires someone who is professional on the phone, sharp with details, and relentless about follow-through. If a lead goes cold on your watch because nobody followed up, that is on you. If an estimate goes out late because the prep work was not done, that is on you. This is a high-accountability role with direct impact on company revenue.



YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Estimate Coordination



When a new lead comes in, pull the property address, research it (Google Maps, county appraisal records, Zillow), and build a pre-filled estimate shell with all available project info before the CEO sits down to price it

Manage the estimate tracker — every active estimate has a status, a follow-up date, and an owner

Send completed estimates to clients via GHL or
, confirm receipt, and log the send

Follow up on unsent or pending estimates and flag anything sitting longer than 48 hours



Lead Follow-Up



Every inbound lead that does not respond within 24 hours gets a follow-up call or message from you — not a bot, a real human conversation

Execute a minimum 5-touch follow-up sequence per lead: call, text,
, call, final close-out

Log every touchpoint inside GoHighLevel CRM with accurate notes and next steps

Flag hot leads, dead leads, and stalled leads to the CEO daily — no surprises



Client Communication Support



Handle routine client communication: sending contracts for e-signature, following up on unsigned documents, answering basic project status questions

Manage the CEO's client-facing inbox for both TEC and GCS — draft responses for review or send pre-approved responses independently

Keep clients informed on project milestones without the CEO having to initiate every update



Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination



Make outbound calls to vendors and subs for pricing, availability, and lead times

Compile and organize pricing responses into a clean format for the CEO to review

Follow up on unanswered vendor requests and maintain a vendor contact log



Pipeline & Calendar Management



Own the sales pipeline inside GHL — every lead is tagged correctly, staged accurately, and moving

Schedule site visits, consultations, and follow-up calls on the CEO's calendar

Send appointment confirmations and reminders to clients 24 hours before scheduled visits

Requirements

# Growth Marketing Specialist (Meta Ads & AI Systems)



**Remote | Part-Time (Approximately 30 Hours/Week Initially) | Potential Long-Term Opportunity**



*(This might not be for you—but perhaps you know someone who would be a great fit. If so, we'd be happy to discuss a referral fee.)*



## About Us



We're a niche education company serving dentists and allied health professionals worldwide through online training, certification, and virtual mentorship programs focused on early interceptive orthodontics and facial growth guidance.



We are on a mission to teach general and pediatric dentists a specialized form of early interceptive orthodontics that addresses the root causes of crooked teeth, facial growth and development issues, and sleep-disordered breathing in children aged 4–10.



By guiding facial growth during a critical developmental window, our approach aims to reduce or eliminate the need for future tooth extractions and braces while supporting healthier airways, improved breathing, and better long-term facial growth.



Based in New York and Australia, we serve dentists and allied health professionals in more than 25 countries—primarily the United States and Australia—through online trainings, live events, certifications, challenges, and mentorship programs.



While our primary focus is educating dentists and allied health professionals, our content and campaigns also attract parents seeking guidance for their children, creating additional opportunities to support practitioner growth and patient care.



You'll work directly with Kean Wong and his dentist brother Dr. Simon Wong, a globally recognized educator in facial growth and early interceptive orthodontics.



We are also affiliated with Star Producer Studios, a video marketing agency that has worked with clients including Tony Robbins and Robert Kiyosaki.



We've only helped around 600 dentists over the past 6+ years on a largely part-time basis. Our goal is to scale that impact significantly over the coming years.



## The Opportunity



This is not a traditional media buying role.



We're looking for someone who can help us grow the business through a combination of Meta Ads, AI-powered marketing systems, funnel optimization, testing, and strategic thinking.



We recently invested in a comprehensive AI-powered marketing operating system that includes pre-built advertising workflows, reporting systems, and AI agents. Your initial focus will be helping us deploy the system, integrate it into our Meta Ads workflow, test outputs, and ensure recommendations align with real-world campaign performance.



You do not need to be a software engineer.



However, you should be comfortable using AI tools, learning new systems quickly, and have enough Meta Ads experience to determine whether AI-generated recommendations, analyses, and strategies make sense in the real world.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow with the business and take on increasing ownership of marketing strategy, customer acquisition, and growth initiatives over time.



## Responsibilities



### Growth Marketing



* Launch, manage, and optimize Meta Ads campaigns

* Monitor and improve lead quality, registrations, applications, and acquisition costs

* Analyze campaign performance and identify growth opportunities

* Develop and test new marketing angles, hooks, and messaging

* Collaborate on funnel optimization and customer acquisition strategy

* Assist with reporting, testing, and performance analysis



### AI-Powered Marketing Systems



* Implement and deploy our AI-powered marketing operating system

* Integrate AI workflows into our Meta Ads processes

* Test and validate AI-generated recommendations

* Improve prompts, workflows, and outputs where necessary

* Identify opportunities to use AI to improve efficiency and performance

* Document systems and processes



## Requirements



### Must Have



* Experience with Meta Ads

* Experience generating leads, webinar registrations, applications, booked calls, or sales through paid advertising

* Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and performance metrics

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

* Active user of AI tools such as Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms

* Strong English communication skills

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership



### Bonus Points



* Experience with webinar, challenge, VSL, or education funnels

* Experience with healthcare, dental, medical, or professional education marketing

* Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, Pabbly, or n8n

* Google Ads experience

*
 and SMS marketing experience

* Funnel-building experience

* Experience leading or managing marketing teams



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will:



* Successfully deploy and operate our AI-powered marketing operating system

* Help launch and optimize Meta Ads campaigns

* Improve marketing reporting and decision-making

* Identify opportunities to improve acquisition performance

* Demonstrate ownership and initiative in helping grow the business



## Compensation



**US$8-12/hour**, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Performance bonuses and compensation increases are available for strong performers.



This role is expected to average approximately **25-30 hours per week initially**, with the potential for increased responsibility and hours as the business grows.



## To Apply



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words:



**FORWARD GROWTH AI**



Then send:



* Your resume

* A short cover note explaining why you're interested

* A brief description of the most successful marketing campaign or growth initiative you have worked on

* A brief explanation of how you currently use AI tools in your workflow



### Required Loom Submission



Please submit a 3–5 minute Loom video explaining:



* A marketing campaign, system, automation, or workflow you helped implement

* The problem it solved

* Your role in the project

* The outcome achieved



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Copy Challenge



Write 3
 ad hooks promoting a free webinar for general dentists on early interceptive orthodontics and facial growth guidance.



Keep each hook under 30 words.



### Final Question



Imagine you are implementing a new AI-powered marketing system designed to support Meta Ads decision-making.



What are the first three things you would verify before trusting the system's recommendations, and why?



We're looking for someone who combines marketing judgment, curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to learn—not just someone who knows how to use AI tools.

# Contract Canva Designer (Potential Full-Time Opportunity)



We are looking for a detail-oriented Canva Designer to help us redesign and organize a large library of marketing collateral.



### Project Overview



We have approximately 150 existing pieces of collateral that need to be recreated and modernized inside Canva. These assets include:



* Guides

* Checklists

* Infographics

* eBooks

* Worksheets

* Marketing resources

* Other branded PDF collateral



All source PDFs will be provided. Your role will be to recreate these assets in Canva while maintaining brand consistency and improving overall design quality where appropriate.



### Responsibilities



* Redesign existing PDFs into editable Canva templates

* Ensure layouts are clean, modern, and professional

* Organize folders, templates, and assets within our Canva account

* Maintain consistent branding across all materials

* Create fully editable Canva files for future internal use

* Generate a shareable Canva link for each completed asset

* Create a thumbnail image for each piece that can be used on landing pages and resource libraries

* Assist with general Canva account organization and cleanup



### Deliverables



For each completed collateral piece, you will provide:



* An editable Canva design

* A shareable Canva link

* A downloadable PDF version

* A thumbnail image suitable for website and landing page use



### Compensation



* Fixed contract payment: **$1,000**

* Approximately **150 collateral pieces** to redesign

* Work can be completed during normal daytime hours

* Flexible schedule as long as deadlines are met



### Bonus Skills (Preferred)



The following experience is not required but will be strongly considered:



* GoHighLevel landing page design

* Funnel design and optimization

* Marketing automation experience

* Conversion-focused design



### Growth Opportunity



We are also looking to fill a future **full-time design position**. Designers who perform well on this project may be considered for a permanent role.



Please note:



* The future full-time position would be a **night shift role**

* GoHighLevel experience will be a significant advantage for full-time consideration



### Requirements



* Strong Canva portfolio

* Experience designing marketing collateral and lead magnets

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to follow brand guidelines

* Reliable communication and project management skills

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



### To Apply



Please send:



1. A link to your Canva portfolio or samples

2. Examples of guides, eBooks, checklists, or infographics you have designed

3. Any GoHighLevel landing pages or funnels you have built (if applicable)

4. Your estimated turnaround time for the project



We are looking for someone who can produce clean, professional marketing assets efficiently and who may be interested in growing into a larger role with our company.

title: Junior Bookkeeper
description:
We're Bullseye Bookkeeping, a US-based bookkeeping firm run by a CPA, serving small business owners across a range of industries (restaurants, real estate, trades, professional services, and more). We pride ourselves on clean, accurate books and reliable turnaround for our clients. We're looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper to join our team and take ownership of recurring data-entry and bookkeeping tasks so our work stays on schedule.



This is a part-time position, roughly 5-10 hours per week to start, with room to grow as we add clients. Your main focus will be accurately entering and organizing financial transactions in QuickBooks Online — much of it taking data from spreadsheets and exports and getting it into QBO correctly and consistently.



What You'll Do

- Post transactions from spreadsheets and exports into QuickBooks Online

- Categorize transactions to the correct accounts based on provided guidelines

- Help keep client books organized and up to date

- Flag anything that looks unusual or doesn't reconcile

- Recommend process improvements and QuickBooks transaction rules that can be added

- Follow established processes and checklists for each client



What We're Looking For

- Proven hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online

- Strong understanding of basic bookkeeping and how transactions hit the books

- Comfortable working in spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets)

- Highly accurate and detail-oriented (in your video submission, tell us what your favorite hobby is outside of work)

- Reliable, responsive, and able to meet deadlines

- Good written English for clear communication

- Able to work independently once trained on our processes



Nice to Have

- Experience with US-based clients and US accounting practices

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification

- Familiarity with payment platforms (Stripe, etc.) or POS exports



How to apply

1. Submit a video introducing yourself and briefly explaining why you think you are a good fit for this role

2. Fill out the Google Form at this link 

3. Submit your Resume/CV

title: Administrative Operations Assistant
description:
Administrative Operations Assistant (Remote)



I own and operate several small businesses in Montana, including landscaping/property maintenance, seasonal retail, manufacturing, and other entrepreneurial ventures. I am looking for a highly organized, proactive assistant who can help me stay on top of the administrative side of business and life.



This is not a traditional “follow instructions all day” role. I need someone who enjoys solving problems, researching answers, organizing information, and helping bring order to a fast-moving environment.



About Me



I am an entrepreneur with multiple businesses, employees, projects, and ideas running at the same time. My strengths are operations, sales, problem-solving, and getting things done. My weakness is paperwork, organization, follow-up, and administrative tasks.



I need someone who can become my right hand and help keep things from falling through the cracks.



Responsibilities May Include



Organizing receipts and expenses

Preparing information for my accountant or bookkeeper

Tracking deadlines, licenses, permits, and renewals

Researching products, vendors, and service providers

Calling companies to gather pricing and information

Organizing files, documents, and
s

Managing calendars and reminders

Creating and tracking task lists

Preparing estimates, proposals, and invoices

Following up on outstanding items

Researching government, policy, and political topics

Assisting with personal administrative tasks as needed



What I’m Looking For



Strong English communication skills

Excellent organization skills

Attention to detail

Ability to learn new software quickly

Comfortable working independently

Good judgment and common sense

Reliable internet connection

Experience with bookkeeping, QuickBooks, spreadsheets, or administrative support is a plus



Communication Expectations



I value initiative.



If you have a question, please try to provide a recommended solution rather than simply asking what to do.



Example:



Instead of:

“How should I categorize this receipt?”



I prefer:

“I believe this receipt should be categorized as equipment maintenance. Please let me know if you disagree.”



I understand questions will come up. However, I am looking for someone who can make reasonable decisions and keep moving forward without needing constant direction.



Hours and Pay



Starting at approximately 10–15 hours per week with the possibility of additional hours for the right person.



Pay based on experience.



To Apply



Please answer the following:



Tell me about your experience with administrative work, bookkeeping, or executive assistance.

What software platforms have you used?

How would you organize a business owner’s receipts, deadlines, and tasks?

Describe a situation where you solved a problem without waiting for instructions.

What are your hourly rate expectations?



Bonus Question:



A business owner sends you a text that says:



“Need pricing on a 60-foot boom lift for next Thursday.”



What steps would you take and what information would you return?

title: Aesthetic Content Creation / Instagram
description:
Job Title: Aesthetic Social Media Content Creator (Western, Americana & Faith-Based)



About the Role



We are looking for a highly creative and visually-driven Social Media Content Creator to join our team. If you have an eye for cinematic, moody, and vintage aesthetics, and you know how to pair striking imagery with powerful typography, this role is for you.



Our brand embodies a rugged, authentic lifestyle—focusing on Western culture, Americana, the great outdoors, and faith-based values. We are looking for someone who can translate this ethos into highly shareable, aesthetic social media posts that resonate deeply with our audience.



What You’ll Do



As our Social Media Content Creator, your primary responsibility will be visual storytelling. You will source, curate, or create high-quality, cinematic imagery that fits our brand’s rugged, outdoor, and Western aesthetic. A significant part of your daily workflow will involve photo editing and color grading. You must be able to apply consistent editing styles to photos to achieve a moody, vintage film look. This includes adding film grain, adjusting exposure for a darker and moody feel, and mastering desaturated, high-contrast color grading. We are not opposed to the use of AI, but it must be tasteful and unrecognizable.



Beyond imagery, you will handle typography and layout. You will design graphic posts by overlaying bold, retro, and serif typography onto the imagery. You will be responsible for placing punchy, meaningful quotes about life, faith, and country living in a way that is visually striking and readable. Your goal is to maintain a highly curated and cohesive social media presence that aligns with our core identity, while also staying up-to-date with social media trends, aesthetic formats, and audio that align with our niche.



What We’re Looking For



We are seeking an individual with a strong aesthetic mastery. You should have a portfolio or personal feed showcasing moody, cinematic, film-grain, or vintage-style photo editing. Alongside your editing skills, you must possess an excellent eye for design and typography, understanding exactly which serif fonts give off that classic, nostalgic Americana feel.



Technical proficiency in photo editing and design software, such as Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, Illustrator, or advanced mobile editing applications, is required. Most importantly, you need a genuine cultural alignment with our brand. We want someone who understands and appreciates the Western lifestyle, vintage Americana, and faith-based messaging, allowing you to speak to this audience authentically. A strong copywriting sensibility to craft or select short, impactful quotes that perfectly match the mood of the imagery is essential.

title: Marketing content coordinator
description:
Marketing Content Coordinator (Part-Time, Remote)

Hours: 5–10 hours/week to start, with room to grow into a larger, long-term role Schedule: Mostly flexible, with some overlap to US Central business hours during launch events Type: Part-time contractor / virtual assistant Pay: [INSERT RATE — e.g. $/hour or $/month] (set your rate before posting)





About Us

We help professional service founders who have built their business on referrals — and who are tired of depending on them — transform into Revenue Leaders who can grow predictably and intentionally. Our clients are smart, experienced founders who want a real system for revenue, not just another course.



We are in an exciting growth phase, building and running marketing launches for our flagship program. You'd be joining a small, focused team at the ground floor of something that is scaling.





The Role

We're looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed Marketing Content Coordinator to keep our content engine running smoothly across organic social,
, and paid. You won't be expected to create strategy or write all the content from scratch — the founder leads on messaging and core content. Your job is to take that content and make it
 format it, schedule it, repurpose it, keep it consistent, and make sure every piece goes out on time and in the right place.



You will work closely with two other people on the team:



The Operations Manager — who owns the tech, funnels, and project timeline. You'll coordinate with them so content lines up with what's being built.

The Ads Manager — who runs paid campaigns. You'll work together so that our social, organic, and paid ads all reinforce the same message instead of pulling in different directions.



When these three channels work in collaboration, our response and conversions improve. Making that collaboration happen day-to-day is the heart of this role.





What You'll Do

Your week-to-week work will include:



Run the content calendar. Keep our LinkedIn (primary channel), Instagram, and
 content organized and scheduled so nothing slips.

Repurpose content across platforms. Turn long-form posts, workshop sessions, videos, and live challenge content into multiple formats — short posts, IG content,
 snippets, and promo pieces.

Schedule and publish. Post and schedule social content; lightly polish and format copy provided by the founder so it reads clean and on-brand.

Create and coordinate creative assets. Request, organize, and create graphics. Make sure the right visuals are ready before each post or campaign goes out.

Keep track of
 campaigns needed and work with founder to create
s. Schedule
 broadcasts, nurture sequences, and event reminders (24h / 1h / live) in our
 platform, and double-check links, tags, and timing before anything sends.

Keep the contact list clean. Maintain list hygiene, tagging, and segmentation so the right people get the right messages.

Manage launch engagement. During our workshop and 3-day challenge events, help with posting, reminders, replays, and replying to comments and DMs so participants stay engaged.

Collect and organize social proof. Gather, format, and file testimonials and client results so they're ready to use in posts and promos.

Coordinate partner & podcast promos. Help organize swipe copy, graphics, and promo dates for JV/affiliate partners and podcast appearances.

Track and report. Keep an eye on content performance (engagement, opt-in rates,
 open/click rates) and flag what's working and what isn't.

Keep channels aligned. Coordinate with the Ads Manager and Operations Manager so the message across organic,
, and paid stays consistent.





Who We're Looking For

You'll do well in this role if you:



Have excellent written English and a good eye for clean, professional copy and formatting

Are highly organized and reliable — you hit deadlines and nothing falls through the cracks

Have experience with Kajabi and member portal management 

Are comfortable in Canva and social scheduling tools

Know your way around LinkedIn and Instagram for business content

Understand the basics of funnels, lead magnets, and online launches (or are eager to learn fast) with a bonus of having worked from James Wedmore's Business By Design 

Are a proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked

Can occasionally overlap with US Central time during live launch events (workshops, challenge days, cart opens/closes)



Bonus if you've supported online course launches, coaching businesses, or B2B founders before.





Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

This starts small and intentional at 5–10 hours per week, but it is built to grow. As our launches scale and the content engine becomes ongoing, the right person can grow into more hours, more ownership, and a long-term core team role. We'd much rather find one great person and grow with them than churn through many.





How to Apply

Please send a short message that includes:



The word "REVENUE" at the top of your application (this tells us you read the full post).

A few sentences on your experience with content scheduling, social media, and
 platforms — tell us which tools you've used.

Links or examples of social content, repurposing, or launch support you've handled.

Your availability and the hours you can overlap with US Central time.



We read every application that follows these steps. We're excited to meet you.

title: QBO Staff Accountant for Accounting Firm (Incredible Benefits with Long-Term Growth)
description:
We are a full-service bookkeeping, accounting, tax, and CFO advisory services firm that is operated almost exclusively by our amazing team in the Philippines. Our focus is on optimizing how our clients use QuickBooks Online (QBO) so we can provide them with financial analytics and dashboards on a recurring basis to help their businesses thrive. Our firm is experiencing much more demand than we can handle, so we need to hire more bookkeepers to manage the onboarding, QBO cleanup, and daily bookkeeping needs of our clients.



Company Culture and Benefits:



We are a vibrant and supportive company. When you speak with our staff in the Philippines, you’ll find that we treat our team with respect and genuinely care for each member. Unlike many other firms, we recognize and value our international tea
mbers as client-facing experts. Your insights and contributions are not only welcomed but are essential to our growth and success.



We want someone who is fun to work with, has a positive attitude, is caring and kind to others in our team, is highly self-directed, highly organized, and has a very high standard for themselves. We also want someone who is willing to receive feedback and looking to continually improve so they can be a part of our team in 5 years, 10 years and even longer term.

What sets Simple Financials apart is our commitment to our team’s well-being and professional development. You are more important than the client; if a client disrespects you, we will prioritize your well-being over their business. Our culture is built on mutual respect, flexibility, and a genuine interest in helping each tea
mber achieve their personal and professional goals. We listen to your feedback and work together to create a supportive and enriching work environment.



• Flexible Work Schedule: During your first three months of Onboarding and Training, it is suggested you come in during CST work hours to maximize your exposure to our company culture and get the training you need to perform at and above expectations. After successfully completing your Onboarding and Training phase, other than the team and client meetings scheduled in CST, you're free to work during your preferred hours.



• Health Insurance Reimbursement: We will reimburse part of your monthly PhilHealth and Social Security System payments for $30 monthly.



• Paid Time Off (PTO): You will start earning vacation leave credits the day you start working at Simple Financials. These leave credits accrue with worked hours, and by working 40 hours per week for the entire year, you will earn:

- 15 days of vacation leave credits per year for the first two years

- 18 days of vacation leave credits per year during your years 3 and 4

- 21 days of vacation leave credits per year after 5 years of tenure

- Unused vacation leaves will be paid out as cash the following year. The actual payout date will be announced separately.



• Paid Holidays: Simple Financials observes specific US holidays. On these days, you will get holiday pay equal to your regular number of hours per day:

• Independence Day (July 4),

• Thanksgiving Day (every 4th Thursday in November),

• Christmas Eve (December 24),

• Christmas Day (December 25),

• New Year’s Day (January 01), and

• New Year’s Eve (December 31)

• Easter Monday (Monday after Easter Sunday)



• Profit Sharing Program: Recently, we have introduced a profit-sharing program for all eligible staff members once they have completed the training and onboarding period. Candidates may also be eligible for profit sharing after 1 year of working with us.



• Company Retreats: To foster employee engagement, we organize in-person retreats or outings that also strengthen camaraderie among our tea
mbers. These usally occur two to three times per year.



• Ad Hoc Bonuses: Periodically, we give bonuses for personal milestones such as Mother’s Day, Birthday, Christmas, etc.



• Advancement, Growth, and Leadership: As we acquire more companies, you will have long-term growth potential for advanced roles and learning. Over the next 3-5 years, the successful applicant would progress in their role with more strategically-focused responsibilities and potentially manage a team of bookkeepers at higher compensation ranging from $30,000 USD (1.7M Philippine pesos) to $40,000 USD (2.25M Philippine pesos) annually.



The Ideal Candidate Will Have the Following Experience in QBO:

• At least one (1) year of working experience using QBO

• Assist in reviewing a client's QBO bookkeeping to identify issues and inaccuracies.

• Creating Journal Entries, monthly, quarterly, and annually for items such as payroll, depreciation, and amortization.

• Categorizing and matching transactions daily and weekly in the banking section.

• Creating invoices, sales receipts, credit memos, expenses, purchase orders, and bills in QBO.

• Accurately using Locations, Classes, and Tags in QBO for better reporting.

• Monthly reconciliations to ensure accuracy.

• Knowledge of advanced reporting features.



Other Requirements:

• Great written and spoken English.

• Timely and professional
 etiquette.

• High-speed internet and reliable computer.

• Professional camera & microphone.

• A quiet space to have confidential and professional conversations with clients.



Compensation



The position will include a three-month training and onboarding period which will be compensated at $6 per hour for the first three months. After this period, compensation can increase to $7 to $8 per hour for the next nine months of working under the current management to advance in their role (more time if needed).

After a year of working with our company, compensation will increase to $8 to $10 per hour, with annual promotions and raises to follow, and can be higher given your level of success in the position.



Plus, all the benefits mentioned above!



To Apply, please click the following link - 



Here, you will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out a 5-minute Experience Questionnaire, and finally take two quick assessments. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow up assessments.



The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then finally a live face-to-face interview with some of my other tea
mbers in the Philippines and an interview with me. Then we will make our final decision.



Please Note: It is best to have already taken your English Proficiency Assessment on your Onlinejobs.ph profile through 
 and the IQ Test through 
 before applying since we will request both of these in the application process. It is not mandatory to have them completed but it will improve your chances of moving along in the process.

title: Executive Assistant to the COO
description:
Executive Assistant to the COO

Full-Time · Remote · US Pacific Hours



 About Us

We are a California-based US company. We move fast, we use AI tools across everything we do, and we're building a small, high-trust team. We're looking for a sharp, reliable Executive Assistant to work directly with our COO.



About the Role

You'll be the operational right hand to our COO — the person who keeps the inbox, calendar, customer and investor coordination, events, recruiting logistics, and daily operations running without friction. This is a high-trust role: you'll handle sensitive customer, investor, and company information, so discretion and reliability are non-negotiable.



This is a long-term, full-time position for someone proactive and detail-obsessed who thinks a step ahead. You won't just execute tasks — you'll protect the COO's time, catch things before they slip, and bring order to a busy schedule.



We are AI-native and strongly prefer candidates comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI note-takers, automations) as part of daily work.



What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will grow as you build trust. Core areas include:



Inbox & Communications

- Triage the inbox daily; surface what's urgent and important

- Group non-urgent items for batch review

- Draft replies for routine
s; follow up on open threads

- Research context on senders or topics when needed



Calendar, Focus Time & Travel

- Own the calendar: schedule, batch similar meetings, defend focus blocks

- Politely push back on or decline low-value meetings

- Coordinate LA-SF travel and event travel (flights, hotels, ground transport)

- Book restaurants and venues for customer and investor meetups



Customer Call Support

- Call leads the day before and again on the day of their meeting to confirm they will attend; if a lead can't make it, remove them from the calendar and reschedule

- Trigger our Airtable automation and surface the prep doc before each call

- Send templated post-call follow-ups from the CRM

- Turn AI note-taker output into clean, structured summaries (key quotes, FAQs, cross-call learnings)

- Organize recordings and notes into Drive



Investor & Fundraising Coordination

- Schedule investor meetings using set time-window rules; send calendar invites

- Assemble pre-call prep docs and drop them in the right Drive folder before each call

- Keep the COO on schedule for the monthly investor update; send it to the investor list only after the COO has written and approved it

- Track and remind on important investor follow-ups



Events

- Source relevant customer- and investor-facing events

- Register us and add to the calendar

- Build prep cards on who to meet

- Help coordinate intros before and follow-ups after



Recruiting Coordination

- Schedule candidate calls

- Send standard rejection
s

- Do light pre-interview research on candidates

- Maintain the sourcing list



Legal & Vendor Coordination

- Track back-and-forth with our law firm and remind the COO to respond quickly (administrative tracking only — no legal work)

- Maintain a list of paid subscriptions; flag renewals before auto-charge; surface and (with approval) cancel unused tools

- Coordinate with our bookkeeper rather than duplicate work



CRM, Drive & File Organization

- Keep the Airtable CRM clean: log interactions, add contacts, update status fields

- Organize Drive across customer, investor, internal, and legal folders

- Maintain clean file-naming and folder structure



Social Media Support

- Monitor LinkedIn, X, and YouTube for our company accounts and leadership

- Surface DMs and comments that need a response

- Draft responses and post with approval; escalate anything sensitive with a suggested draft



Industry Intel Briefing

- Deliver a daily or weekly digest of construction/AEC industry news, competitor moves, and updates on our customers and prospects — in a 5-minute skim format



Who We're Looking For

- 2+ years experience as an EA, VA, or operations assistant, ideally supporting a founder or executive

- Excellent written English AND strong spoken English — you will be making confirmation calls to US-based leads, so a clear, professional phone manner is required

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you don't let things slip

- Proactive and confident enough to defend a calendar and push back on low-value requests, politely

- Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information

- Comfortable with AI tools and quick to learn new software

- Reliable internet with a backup connection

- Able to work full-time on US Pacific hours (overnight in the Philippines)



Work Setup

- Full-time, 48 hours/week, Monday to Saturday

- Hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM US Pacific Time

- 100% remote, work from home

- Tools: Google Workspace, Airtable, 
, Hubstaff, Tailscale VPN, AI note-takers

- Your time is tracked with Hubstaff during working hours

- Your screen and camera must be shared on 
 during all working hours



Compensation

- $3-$5/hour USD, depending on experience

- Paid monthly via Wise — payment is made 15 days after the first of the following month

- Long-term role with room to grow in responsibility and rate



How to Apply

Please follow these steps carefully — applications that don't follow them will not be reviewed:



1. Start your application with the word **COMPASS** so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a short note about your relevant EA/VA experience and why US hours work for you.

3. Attach your resume.

4. Record a short Loom video (2-3 minutes), camera on, no script. Tell us who you are, walk us through your relevant experience, and share one example of a time you managed a busy executive's inbox or calendar — or caught something important before it slipped.



By applying, please confirm you understand and agree to:

- Sharing your screen AND keeping your camera on for all hours you are working, with your time tracked by Hubstaff

- Working US Pacific hours, Monday to Saturday (overnight in the Philippines)

- Monthly payment via Wise, made 15 days after the first of the following month



We review every complete application and respond to strong candidates. We look forward to meeting you.

title: Paralegal – Criminal Defense (Law Graduate)
description:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

        reductions.

Application Process:

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented

title: iOS & Android App Developer
description:
Senior Mobile Developer / Development Team — iOS & Android

Full-Time Engagement  •  Long-Term  •  Start to Finish + Ongoing Maintenance



IMPORTANT: This posting is for a long-term, full-time engagement — not a one-off project. We are building a complete consumer mobile platform from scratch and need a committed development partner for the full build lifecycle and beyond. Please only apply if you are available full-time and interested in a multi-month engagement with continued maintenance responsibilities after launch.





Overview

We are a US-based startup building a consumer mobile application for iOS and Android. The platform combines social discovery, real-time location features, and community scheduling — targeting an active adult demographic in major US cities. Full concept details are shared under NDA with shortlisted candidates.

We have a completed Figma design, a detailed product specification, and UI mockups ready to hand off. We are ready to begin immediately and are looking for a technical partner who will own this from day one through launch and beyond — not a one-off contractor.



Note: We are intentionally keeping the specifics of the concept vague in this posting to protect our IP. Shortlisted candidates will receive a full product specification document under NDA before the interview stage.





What We Are Building

The app has the following core functional areas. Details are intentionally high-level — full specification shared under NDA at the shortlist stage:



User accounts and onboarding

 • Multi-step onboarding with media upload and user preference configuration

 • Optional identity verification via a third-party service

 • Profile badge system with free and paid tiers

 • Peer review and rating system



Content and user discovery

 • Grid-based browse interface with expandable detail views

 • Feed-based discovery with filter and sort

 • Real-time interactive map view with live status indicators — a signature feature

 • Username search



User-generated listings and scheduling

 • Users can create, manage, and publish listings

 • Request-to-join flow with host approval controls

 • Architecture must support high concurrent participation per listing

 • Real-time status changes reflected on the map

 • Granular host controls over messaging permissions



Activity feed

 • Social feed of user activity

 • User activity logging with tagging and feed posting

 • Likes, comments, shares on feed posts



Messaging

 • Gated in-app direct messaging

 • Chat access controlled by specific in-app conditions

 • Full-featured messaging UI

 • Push notifications throughout



Trust and reputation system

 • Optional post-interaction rating and review

 • Blind mutual rating system

 • Trust and reputation system displayed on profiles

 • Rating eligibility tied to verified participation



User safety and controls

 • Block, report, and content moderation controls

 • User preference and safety filtering

 • Location privacy controls

 • Visibility controls for users



Navigation

 • Multi-tab bottom navigation covering the core feature areas

 • Full navigation spec provided to shortlisted candidates



Monetization infrastructure (architecture only at launch)

None of the following are active at launch. All must be architected in from day one so they can be switched on without a rebuild. This is a non-negotiable requirement.

 • Payment processing via Stripe — integrated but dormant at launch, activatable for subscriptions, one-time purchases, and transaction fees

 • Tiered user badge system — free and paid badge types must be supported in the data model from day one; new badge types must be addable without schema changes

 • Ad slot architecture — designated injectable ad placements in the feed (between posts), at the top and bottom of key screens, and within browse/discovery views; placements must be swappable between house content and third-party ad network (e.g. Google AdMob) without UI rebuilds

 • Modular map/globe component — the map view must be built as a fully modular component so that multiple independent map instances can be added later (e.g. a separate map layer for partner businesses, local deals, or events) without rearchitecting the core feature

 • Premium user tier support — the user model must support a premium flag from day one; gating logic for features such as increased listing limits, promoted visibility, and boosted content must be implementable by flipping a config, not rewriting components

 • Business/partner account type — the user model must support a separate account type for businesses or organisations, distinct from individual user accounts, activatable post-launch

 • Promoted content slots — listings and profiles must support a promoted/sponsored flag in the data model so boosted content can be surfaced in feeds and discovery views without UI changes





Technical Requirements

We are open to React Native (Expo) or Flutter — we trust you to propose the framework you are most confident shipping great consumer apps in. What matters is the outcome, not the framework. The remaining tools below are strongly preferred and candidates should have direct experience with them or clear equivalents.



Preferred stack (open to discussion)

 • React Native (Expo) or Flutter — we are open to either, single codebase for iOS and Android. Tell us which you recommend and why in your application.

 • Supabase — Postgres database, Auth, Realtime, and Storage

 • Supabase Realtime for live data sync (map pins, session status, chat)

 • Mapbox SDK or Google Maps SDK for the globe/map feature — Mapbox strongly preferred for globe rendering

 • Expo Notifications + OneSignal for push notifications

 • Stripe for payment architecture (integration required, activation deferred)

 • Clerk or Supabase Auth for Google and Apple sign-in



Required experience

 • Minimum 3 published apps in the App Store or Google Play — links required in application

 • Prior experience building real-time features (live maps, chat, activity feeds)

 • Prior experience building consumer social or marketplace apps

 • Clean, maintainable, well-commented code — we will review code samples before hiring

 • Experience with App Store and Google Play submission and review processes

 • TypeScript preferred





Engagement Terms



This is a full-time engagement

We are not looking for someone to work on this between other projects. We need a developer or team who will treat this as their primary focus for the duration of the build. We expect 35–40 hours per week minimum during the active build phase.



Timeline

 • Active build phase: approximately 4–5 months

 • Post-launch maintenance and feature development: ongoing, long-term

 • We expect the winning candidate to be available for at least 12 months total



Post-launch expectations

 • Bug fixes and OS compatibility updates as iOS and Android release new versions

 • App Store compliance updates as Apple and Google update policies

 • Feature additions on a rolling roadmap we will define together post-launch

 • Availability for urgent issues within 24 hours



Preferred candidate type

 • Small agency (2–4 people) or a senior lead developer with a trusted sub-contractor network

 • Someone who has seen a project from zero to App Store before — multiple times

 • Fluent written English is required — you will be communicating with US-based founders daily





How to Apply

We receive a high volume of applications and filter aggressively. To be considered, your application must include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not receive a response.



Required in your application

 • Links to at least 3 live apps you have built in the App Store or Google Play. Not screenshots, not videos — actual downloadable app links.

 • A brief description of the most technically complex app you have shipped and specifically what made it complex.

 • Your experience with Supabase Realtime specifically. If you have not used it, tell us what real-time tool you have used instead and why.

 • Your experience with map or globe integrations in a mobile app — Mapbox or Google Maps. Describe what you built.

 • Confirmation that you are available full-time and can begin within 2 weeks.

 • Your proposed hourly rate or monthly retainer for the build phase, and your expected rate for the ongoing maintenance phase. Please also include a proposed schedule of deliverables with estimated milestones and your projected timeline to completion. We expect weekly or biweekly check-in calls with the founding team and ask that you confirm you are available for these.

 • To confirm you have read this posting in full, begin your application with the phrase: “Mobile ready.” Applications that do not start with this phrase will not be reviewed.



Shortlisting process: Top applicants will be invited to a 30-minute video call. Following the call, finalists will be given a small paid test task (compensated at your stated rate) before a final offer is made. We will not ask you to work for free at any stage.





What We Offer

 • Competitive hourly rate or monthly retainer — we pay fairly for quality

 • Full product specification document and Figma designs provided on day one — no guessing what to build

 • Direct access to founders for fast decision-making — no corporate approval chains

 • Long-term relationship — if you do great work, you will have work for years

 • Milestone-based payments through Upwork escrow — protected for both sides

 • A genuinely interesting, well-scoped product with real market potential in a growing category





We are serious founders building a serious product. We want a serious development partner.

If that sounds like you, we look forward to hearing from you.
