title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: STORAGE SURVEY ANALYST
description:
Company: Coulmed Products — Medical Equipment & Sterile Processing Storage Solutions (Springfield, NJ, USA)

Employment Type: Independent Contractor, Full-Time (8 hrs/day, Mon–Fri)

Work Hours: U.S. East Coast hours (EST/EDT — typically 8:30 AM–5:00 PM New York time / 8:30 PM–5:00 AM Manila time)

Salary: ?70,000 – ?100,000 per month, depending on experience

Positions Available: 2



About Coulmed Products

Coulmed Products designs and sells the SteriRack modular storage system (by Space Logic) to hospitals and surgery centers across the United States. When a hospital is considering our system, we analyze photos and walkthrough videos of their current sterile storage rooms, count and measure everything on their shelves, and produce a data-driven proposal showing exactly how much space they will gain with SteriRack.

You will be the engine of that analysis.



What You Will Do

- Analyze site photos and walkthrough videos of hospital sterile storage rooms, pausing/screenshotting video to inspect each bay of shelving.

- Count and classify surgical instrument trays into height categories (4", 6", 8"+, and long trays) using visual estimation — wrapped trays, rigid containers, and peel-pack pouches.

- Estimate soft goods volume (sterile items packaged in bags/pouches) and translate it into basket capacity.

- Complete our Facts & Data workbook (Excel) for each project: tray counts per cart/bay, in-service growth factor, total trays, baskets needed (e.g., 400x600, doublewide), number of SteriRack bays, and elevation assignments.

- Flag ambiguous items — when an angle, blur, or obstruction prevents a confident count, document it and ask rather than guess.

- Support proposal output: your data feeds the customer-facing summary showing storage capacity gained. Over time you may help build the bay/elevation layouts and gain-summary documents themselves.

- Log hours in Jibble and attend a short daily check-in with the U.S. team.



What Success Looks Like:

- Counts are accurate and consistent — two analysts looking at the same photo should land within a tray or two of each other.

- Workbooks are complete, clean, and delivered on schedule (typically 1–3 business days per facility survey).

- Ambiguities are flagged, not buried.



Who We're Looking For

Required:

- Strong visual/spatial estimation — comfortable judging item heights and quantities from photos and video.

- High attention to detail and tolerance for repetitive, methodical screen work.

- Solid Excel skills (data entry, basic formulas; you don't need to be a formula wizard — the workbook does the math).

- Strong written English; able to write clear notes and questions.

- Reliable home office: fast internet (?25 Mbps), a computer that can smoothly play/scrub HD video, dual monitors preferred.

- Able to work U.S. East Coast (EST) hours, full-time.



Strongly preferred backgrounds (any one of these):

- Quantity takeoff / construction estimating assistant

- CAD drafting or design assistant (architecture, kitchens/closets, millwork)

- Inventory control, warehouse slotting, or supply chain analysis

- Medical records, medical coding, or claims photo review

- Sterile processing (SPD/CSSD) or OR materials experience — a big plus; you'll already know what a rigid container vs. a wrapped tray vs. a peel pack looks like

- Not required: an engineering degree, U.S. healthcare experience, or sales skills. This is an analysis role, not a phone role.



Compensation & Terms

- ?70,000–?100,000/month based on experience and trial performance

- Independent contractor agreement; paid 2-week working trial; 12-month renewable term after the trial

- Hours logged via Jibble; performance reviewed against accuracy and turnaround benchmarks



How to Apply

- Submit the following (applications without the video will not be considered):

- A 2–3 minute video (or audio if camera is unavailable) introducing yourself: your background, the most detail-oriented work you've done, and why overnight EST hours work for your situation. Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted link is fine.

- Your resume/CV.

- One sentence describing your internet speed and computer setup (include a screenshot of a speedtest.net result if possible).

title: Shopify Customer Experience Manager for HOOKS! by Craggy Games
description:
Craggy Games is hiring a customer experience manager for HOOKS!, our tabletop ring-toss game.



This is not a generic
 support role. We need someone who can own customer experience for a small DTC ecommerce brand: answer customers quickly, investigate orders in Shopify, handle missing or damaged pieces, protect gift and holiday experiences, organize support patterns, improve macros/SOPs, and communicate clearly with the owner.



This role is seasonal and flexible. Most days are not a flood of tickets, but the work matters when a customer 
nt happens. Expect about 15-25 hours/week to start, with the ability to scale up during holidays, gifting rushes, launches, and busy periods.



We have already built an internal CX knowledge system that captures our brand voice, support rules, real customer cases, macros, Shopify workflows, and edge cases. You will use that system, improve it, and help us build a smarter support operation around it.



You will handle:

- Customer
 support

- Shopify order lookups

- WISMO tickets, tracking, fulfillment status, carrier delays, delivery issues, and pre-order updates

- Missing-piece, damaged-item, replacement-part, return, cancel, and swap workflows

- Product/rules/setup questions

- Wholesale, bulk, gifting, and event inquiry triage

- Reviews, unhappy customers, and escalation notes

- Weekly reporting to the owner

- Macro, FAQ, SOP, support workbook, and AI-assisted CX system improvements



Accuracy matters more than sounding polished. You must be comfortable checking the full
 thread and Shopify order before promising anything.



Examples:

- If a customer asks where an order is, you check fulfillment status, tracking, tags, and pre-order signals before replying.

- If a refund, replacement, swap, or return label is needed, the customer only hears that it is done after it is actually done.

- If a customer has
ed multiple times, you treat that as more serious even if they are polite.

- If something looks like a product trend, you log it internally instead of telling the customer it is a known issue.



Required:

- 2+ years customer support or VA experience

- Ecommerce support experience

- Shopify admin experience

- Strong written English

- Comfortable with Google Workspace

- Able to write concise internal notes and weekly reports

- Reliable internet and quiet work setup

- Able to overlap with US Eastern time

- Careful enough to read full context before replying

- Interested in improving systems, not just answering tickets



Nice to have:

- Gorgias, Zendesk, HelpScout, Freshdesk, Reamaze, Intercom, or similar

- Experience with games, toys, hobbies, gifts, events, or entertainment brands

- Returns/exchanges, fulfillment issues, pre-order workflows, or chargeback prevention

- Klaviyo or basic
 marketing familiarity

- Experience improving FAQs, SOPs, macros, and support reports

- Experience using AI tools or structured knowledge bases to improve support quality



Schedule:

Part-time hourly role to start. Preferred 15-25 hours/week with consistent weekday availability and at least 3-4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time. Hours may increase during busy seasonal periods.



Compensation:

$6-$12/hour depending on experience, Shopify depth, writing quality, and reliability. We will likely begin with a paid 2-week trial, then move into a long-term role if it is a strong fit.



Please answer these questions when applying:

1. What Shopify tasks have you personally handled?

2. Which customer support tools have you used?

3. Tell me about a time you handled an upset ecommerce customer. What happened and what did you do?

4. Have you handled missing/damaged items, WISMO, returns, or gifting/holiday urgency?

5. Are you available for US Eastern time overlap? If yes, what hours?

6. What hourly rate are you looking for?

7. What is your process before telling a customer that a refund, replacement, or return label is complete?



Please also write a sample customer response:

Customer says: "I ordered HOOKS! last week and still do not have tracking. I needed it for a gift this weekend. This is really frustrating. Can you cancel it?"



Write the response you would send, assuming you need to first check Shopify and fulfillment status before promising anything.



Also write the internal note you would create before d
 the final response.

title: DME Billing and Reimbursement Specialist
description:
Seeking detailed-oriented DME Billing and Reimbursement Specialist with experience in Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing. Skilled in claims submission, denial resolution, accounts receivable management, insurance verification, and reimbursement compliance. Proficient in medical billing software, HCPCS/CPT coding and revenue cycle management with a proven ability to maximize reimbursement and reduce claim denials.



Essential Responsibilities



Submit clean claims and monitor claims to Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial Insurance, and Workers' Compensation Payers.

• Follow up on outstanding claims through final resolution.

• Review, analyze, and resolve denied, rejected, or underpaid claims.

• Analyzing complex billing issues, ensuring payer compliance, and collaborating with patients, providers, and our team to achieve timely claim resolution and optimal financial outcomes

• Research claim discrepancies and determines root causes of payment issues.

• Correct billing errors and resubmit claims within payer filing deadlines.

• Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs).

• Post payments, contractual adjustments, and denials accurately.

• Prepare and submit appeals and reconsiderations with supporting documentation.

• Respond to payer requests for additional information and medical records.

• Communicate with insurance carriers regarding claim status, eligibility, authorization, and reimbursement issues.

• Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits

• Reviewing physician orders and supporting documentation

• Educate patients regarding insurance coverage, balances, and payment options.

• Establish payment arrangements when appropriate.

• Maintain accurate account documentation and billing records.

• Utilize Brightree, Availity, MyCGS, TMHP, and other payer portals to manage claims and reimbursement activity.

• Assist with prior authorization and insurance verification processes as needed.

• Identify trends in denials and recommend process improvements.

• Meet productivity and quality standards while managing a high-volume workload.

• Maintain compliance with HIPAA and company policies.

• Perform other duties as assigned.



Qualifications



Education & Experience

High School Diploma or GED required.

• Knowledge of medical billing and coding (ICD-10, HCPCS, CPT) coding principles.

• Minimum of 1-3+ years of experience in medical billing, reimbursement, and accounts receivable

• Understanding of Medicare Part B and Medicaid payer guidelines



Knowledge & Skills

Strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial Insurance, TRICARE, and Workers' Compensation billing guidelines.

• Experience with claims follow-up, denial management, appeals, and reimbursement processes.

• Proficiency with EMR/EHR systems, clearinghouses, and Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.



Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency with Brightree, Availity, EMR/EHR systems, clearinghouses, Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat.

• Experience with claims follow-up, denial management, appeals, and reimbursement processes with DME billing and reimbursement.

• Advanced knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid documentation and coverage requirements.

• Experience working high-volume accounts receivable and collections.



Success in This Role

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and committed to achieving timely and accurate reimbursement while providing outstanding service to patients, providers, and payer partners. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, maintain a high level of accuracy, and continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

title: Learn Management System implementation specialist
description:
# Job Description: Learning Management System Specialist



## Position Overview



Nexlar is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Learning Management System Specialist to help build, organize, improve, and manage our online training platform. This person will be responsible for setting up the learning management system, uploading courses, improving course content, organizing training materials, managing certificates, and ensuring the system is easy to use for students, employees, and administrators.



The ideal candidate should have experience working with learning management systems, online course platforms, training content, certificates, and basic technical setup. This role requires strong organization, attention to detail, creativity, and the ability to improve the learning experience.



## Key Responsibilities



### Learning Management System Setup



Set up and configure the learning management system according to company needs.



Organize the platform structure, including courses, modules, lessons, quizzes, users, categories, and learning paths.



Customize the LMS settings, branding, navigation, permissions, and user roles.



Make sure the system is easy to access, professional-looking, and simple for users to navigate.



Troubleshoot basic LMS issues and coordinate with technical support when needed.



### Course Uploading and Organization



Upload course materials, including videos, PDFs, presentations, documents, quizzes, assignments, and other training content.



Organize courses into clear modules and lessons.



Ensure all uploaded materials are properly labeled, formatted, and easy to follow.



Review uploaded content to confirm that links, videos, quizzes, and downloads are working correctly.



Maintain a clean and professional course layout.



### Course Improvement and Content Development



Review existing courses and recommend improvements to make them more engaging, professional, and effective.



Improve course structure, wording, visuals, formatting, quizzes, and learning flow.



Help convert raw training materials into polished online courses.



Create or improve course descriptions, learning objectives, lesson summaries, and instructions.



Identify gaps in course content and suggest additional materials where needed.



### Certificates and Completion Tracking



Set up certificates of completion for courses and training programs.



Customize certificate templates with company branding, student names, course names, completion dates, and signatures if required.



Configure automatic certificate generation upon course completion.



Track learner progress, course completion, quiz results, and certificate issuance.



Generate reports related to course activity, user progress, and training completion.



### User Management and Support



Add, organize, and manage users inside the LMS.



Assign users to the correct courses or training programs.



Help users with login issues, course access, certificates, and general LMS navigation.



Provide basic instructions or guides for students, employees, and administrators.



Maintain accurate records of course enrollment and completion.



### Quality Control



Test courses before publishing to ensure everything works properly.



Check videos, links, quizzes, certificates, forms, and downloadable materials.



Ensure course content is accurate, professional, and aligned with company standards.



Maintain consistency across all courses and certificates.



## Required Skills and Experience



Experience working with a learning management system or online course platform.



Ability to upload and organize online courses, videos, documents, quizzes, and training materials.



Experience setting up certificates, completion rules, and course tracking.



Strong attention to detail and organization.



Ability to improve course content, layout, and user experience.



Basic technical troubleshooting skills.



Good written communication skills.



Ability to work independently and complete tasks on schedule.



Familiarity with online training, e-learning, instructional design, or course development is preferred.



## Preferred Experience



Experience with platforms such as Moodle, TalentLMS, LearnDash, Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable, Canvas, Docebo, Absorb LMS, or similar systems.



Basic graphic design or formatting skills.



Experience creating quizzes, assessments, and certificates.



Experience improving training content for employees, customers, or students.



Knowledge of SCORM, course completion rules, automation, or reporting tools is a plus.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is organized, reliable, creative, and comfortable working with technology. They should be able to take existing training materials and turn them into professional online courses. They should also be able to manage the LMS, improve the learning experience, and make sure users receive certificates after completing their training.



## Job Type



Full-time, part-time, or contract depending on experience and availability.



## Work Location



Remote or hybrid, depending on company needs.

You'll work alongside the whole team — receiving task briefs via Loom recordings, written docs, and Slack from Callum and the rest of the team. You'll execute independently: problem-solving on your own first, using AI tools to figure things out, and asking smart questions when you genuinely need direction. You won't be micromanaged, but you will be held to a high standard.



AI is not a side skill here — it's the job. You'll use Claude, ChatGPT, and Claude Code daily: building automations, debugging broken workflows, drafting landing pages, writing Airtable scripts, and finding faster ways to do everything. If you're the type who reaches for AI before reaching for a tutorial, you'll fit right in.



If you go above and beyond for us, we go above and beyond for you. We're not shy about bonuses when the work speaks for itself.



## SUCCESS METRICS



- System reliability: automations, dashboards, and integrations run error-free across client accounts

- Build quality: every automation is clean and easy for the team to understand

- Speed: tasks completed efficiently without sacrificing quality

- Visibility: every task logged in Notion with a clear process and record of what you've done

- Initiative: you regularly suggest improvements nobody asked for

- Communication: daily Slack updates, proactive flagging of issues, responsive at all times



## CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



### Automation Building & Maintenance



- Build and optimize automations in 
, Zapier, and/or n8n across multiple client accounts

- Build and maintain GoHighLevel workflows, automations, and campaigns

- Troubleshoot failed workflows and restore full functionality fast

- Connect data flows between Airtable, Google Sheets, Close CRM, ActiveCampaign, and Slack

- Build AI directly into automations — classification, drafting, enrichment, routing



### AI-Powered Execution



- Use Claude and ChatGPT as your first stop for problem-solving, debugging, and building

- Use Claude Code (or similar) for scripts, Airtable automations, and small internal tools

- Quality-check and refine AI output — AI does the groundwork, you direct and polish

- Spot places where AI can replace manual work, then build it



### CRM & Data Infrastructure



- Set up and maintain Close CRM pipelines, tags, and configurations

- Set up and maintain ActiveCampaign
 sequences with conditional logic

- Build and manage Airtable bases, dashboards, scripts, and reporting systems

- Maintain data hygiene across all client dashboards, tracking sheets, and CRMs — we pride ourselves on accurate, in-depth data

- Create reliable webhook systems for lead capture, payment tracking, and reporting



### Landing Pages & Client-Facing Assets



- Build and iterate on landing pages — AI does the groundwork, you direct, refine, and quality-check

- Perform quality control on funnels — test every step from opt-in to payment

- Ensure new funnels and offers integrate cleanly with the CRM and automation stack



### Process & Communication



- Log every task in Notion with a clear process and visibility on what you've done

- Record Looms for training and reference when building new systems

- Communicate daily progress, blockers, and completed work via Slack

- Flag issues before anyone has to ask



## TOOLS & TECH STACK



- Automation: Make, Zapier, n8n, GoHighLevel

- Data & Dashboards: Airtable, Google Sheets

- CRM & Marketing: Close CRM, ActiveCampaign, GoHighLevel

- AI: Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Manus

- Web: Landing page builders, funnel tools

- Documentation: Notion, Loom

- Communication: Slack



## REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent written and spoken English — non-negotiable

- Strong, demonstrable AI proficiency — you use Claude or ChatGPT daily and can show real work built with them

- Experience building real automations in at least 3 of the tools listed above

- Strong technical and operational mindset — you connect the build and the business logic behind it

- Skilled at troubleshooting — you can diagnose why something broke and fix it fast

- Familiar with webhooks, APIs, and data mapping between tools

- Attention to detail — broken links, missed triggers, and sloppy data are unacceptable

- Clear, proactive communicator — updates, questions, and flags without being chased

- Reliable computer with fast, stable internet (working 95% of the time)

- Comfortable working autonomously from Loom briefs and written docs



Big plus:



- Familiarity with Claude Code or AI coding assistants

- Knowledge of the coaching, agency, or info product space

- Landing page design and web page building



## WHAT WE VALUE



- Initiative — you don't wait to be told what to do when something is obviously broken

- Hunger — you want to learn, grow, and take on more responsibility over time

- Self-sufficiency — you use Claude, ChatGPT, YouTube, and documentation before asking for help

- Care — you treat every client's system like it's your own business

- Communication — you never leave people guessing where things stand

- Honesty — if you're stuck or made a mistake, you say so immediately



## WHAT EXCELLENCE LOOKS LIKE



Every automation runs silently. Issues are solved before anyone notices. You ship improvements without being asked. When you get a brief, you deliver what was asked and suggest what wasn't.



## ROLE STRUCTURE



- 15-20 hours per week

- Our team works primarily Eastern Time (EST) but we're flexible — schedule can be arranged around what suits you

- You'll work with the full team and occasionally communicate with clients in shared Slack channels

- Compensation: $400-$600/month depending on experience, with a clear path to $1,200+/month as you grow with us

- We'll move from hourly tracking to a fixed monthly rate once we understand the workload and your output speed, typically within the first 1-2 months

- Long-term role with room to grow into more hours and responsibility — not a quick freelance gig



Note: put the number '31' somewhere in your application so we know you've read this entire description.

title: Outreach Specialist
description:
**Virtual Assistant / Outreach Specialist for Marketing Agency**



We are a Los Angeles-based marketing agency looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to help with daily outreach to small businesses.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident speaking on the phone, has strong English communication skills, and is comfortable reaching out to potential clients through calls,
s, and messages.



**What You’ll Be Doing:**



* Making daily outreach calls to potential clients

* Sending follow-up
s and messages

* Finding and organizing leads

* Tracking outreach activity in a spreadsheet or CRM

* Booking interested prospects for sales calls

* Following scripts while still sounding natural and professional

* Reporting daily progress and results



**What We’re Looking For:**



* Strong English speaking skills with a clear, professional phone presence

* Comfortable talking on the phone with business owners

* Reliable, organized, and consistent

* Able to work late nights because we are based in Los Angeles, California

* Experience with cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or sales is a plus

* Able to follow instructions carefully

* Good internet connection and a quiet place to work

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn



**Pay:**



* $2–$4 per hour depending on experience

* Opportunity for performance bonuses when appointments are booked or deals close

* Long-term opportunity for the right person



**Schedule:**



We are based in Los Angeles, California, so you must be available to work during U.S. business hours or late-night hours in your local time zone.



**Voice Recording Requirement:**



Since this role involves speaking with business owners over the phone, a voice recording is required to apply.



Please send a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



* Your name

* Your previous experience with outreach, sales, cold calling, or appointment setting

* Why you think you would be a good fit for this role



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



**How to Apply:**



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with cold calling, outreach, sales, or appointment setting

3. A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself

4. Your internet speed screenshot

5. Your availability in Los Angeles time

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Answer this question: What is your favorite color?



Applications that do not answer the favorite color question will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can start soon and become a long-term part of our team.

title: Customer Support Specialist with Gorgias Experience
description:

To help people sleep better, feel better, and live better, by delivering high-quality, natural solutions that truly work.

What We're Looking For

- You MUST have experience with Gorgias (Inbox setup, tagging, automations, macros, rules, customers with priority etc.)

- You genuinely care about helping people

- You write fluent, natural English, with empathy and a human touch

- You’re proactive and think in solutions, not complaints

- You're work very organized, we don't have to ask you things twice

- You’re excited by the idea of growing into a Customer Support Manager

- You are experienced in working with real brands and can name them



Your Responsibilities

- Respond to customer support tickets 
/chat) via Gorgias

- Monitor order issues and proactively follow up with customers

- Work closely with our logistics and operations teams to resolve any shipping or refund issues

- Turn angry customers into loyal fans through empathy and speed

- Help us build a scalable support system (rules, macros, helpdesk articles, etc.)

- Provide feedback to improve our product and customer experience



What Makes This Opportunity Special

We’re not looking for someone to “just answer
s.” We’re building a real brand with thousands of customers, long-term goals, and a product that actually changes lives.



We need someone who can own the customer experience and help us build something that lasts. You’ll be part of a fast-moving team that values:



SPEED - Execute fast without sacrificing quality

IMPACT - Everything we do must create value for the customer

BETTER EVERY DAY - Growth is our default mode



If you thrive in an environment where initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement are expected, you’ll feel right at home.



Oh yeah, we believe in rewarding people who go above and beyond. When you create impact (whether through glowing reviews, improved systems, or customer happiness) we’ll make sure you feel it in your paycheck too.

This starts as a freelance role (15–25h/week) with clear potential to scale to full-time and grow into a CS Manager as we expand internationally.



How to Apply:

Please include a short message explaining:



- Your experience with Gorgias

- DTC Brands you have worked with

- Why this opportunity excites you

Looking forward to meeting you!



Jaimy - MW Collective

Building Strong Brands & Empowering Growth Together

title: ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE
description:
Account Executive (AE) – Strategic Client Growth

Location: Remote

Reports To: Vice President of Sales



Position Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Account Executive (AE) to manage and grow strategic client relationships. This role focuses on maintaining long-term partnerships with existing enterprise clients, ensuring exceptional customer experience, driving account expansion, and supporting ongoing revenue growth.



The Account Executive serves as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts and works closely with clients, operations, leadership, and internal stakeholders to ensure service excellence, contract stability, and business development within existing accounts.



Key Responsibilities

Strategic Client Management

Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned enterprise accounts.



Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships through proactive communication and engagement.



Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.



Account Growth and Revenue Expansion

Identify and pursue opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding service offerings within existing accounts.



Develop strategies to increase account value and generate additional revenue streams.



Collaborate with internal teams to introduce new solutions that address client needs and business objectives.



Contract and Renewal Management

Manage contract renewals and ensure timely execution of renewal agreements.



Facilitate Statements of Work (SOW) amendments, staffing discussions, pricing reviews, and other commercial negotiations.



Support efforts to maintain account profitability and long-term business stability.



Service Delivery and Governance

Partner with clients, vendor managers, operations teams, and leadership to ensure successful service delivery.



Participate in regular governance meetings, business reviews, and client calls.



Establish and maintain escalation processes and governance frameworks to address service issues effectively.



Align internal departments to ensure client expectations and service commitments are met.



Operational Sales Support

Manage day-to-day sales support activities for existing accounts.



Prepare and coordinate pricing proposals, quotes, and related documentation.



Support ongoing account activity and transaction flow while enabling new business sales teams to focus on prospecting and acquisition.



CRM and Reporting

Maintain accurate account records, opportunities, and pipeline data within HubSpot CRM.



Track client interactions, account activity, revenue opportunities, and service-related initiatives.



Generate reports and provide insights on account performance, growth opportunities, and client engagement.



Qualifications

Proven experience managing large-scale enterprise accounts and maintaining long-term customer relationships.



Demonstrated success in account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention.



Experience in IT sales, managed services, IT field services, technology solutions, or related industries preferred.



Strong understanding of account management, customer success, and service delivery principles.



Proficiency with CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot.



Excellent communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.



Experience working with executive-level clients and presenting performance metrics and business insights.



Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.



Bachelor's degree preferred.



Success Measures

Client retention and satisfaction



Revenue growth within assigned accounts



Timely contract renewals and account expansions



Effective cross-functional collaboration



Accurate CRM management and reporting



Achievement of account growth and profitability objectives

title: Client Success & Operations Coordinator - Events
description:
About Us



Sixth Sense Events creates experiential catering, brand activations and immersive event experiences across the UK and Europe.



From liquid nitrogen ice cream, glow in the dark candy floss,  and frozen cocktails to custom-built branded installations, we help agencies and brands create memorable experiences that attract, engage and convert audiences.



We are looking for somebody who thrives on organisation, enjoys solving problems and wants to become a key operational part of a growing events business.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.



You will become the central point connecting clients, suppliers and our production team.



The Role



You will take ownership of the day-to-day administration and coordination of the business, helping ensure that every enquiry, booking and event runs smoothly.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing the company inbox

* Responding to client enquiries

* Preparing proposals and quotations

* Following up leads and opportunities

* Maintaining HubSpot CRM records

* Coordinating suppliers and branding orders

* Arranging travel, accommodation and logistics

* Creating event itineraries and job sheets

* Chasing artwork, approvals and missing information

* Maintaining operational documents and processes

* Improving systems and workflows

* Supporting
 marketing and CRM campaigns

* Using AI tools to improve efficiency and organisation



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for somebody who:



* Is highly organised

* Communicates exceptionally well in writing

* Enjoys creating structure from chaos

* Takes ownership without waiting for instructions

* Is comfortable speaking with clients and suppliers

* Thinks ahead and identifies potential issues

* Has experience using CRM systems

* Is comfortable learning new software

* Understands how to prioritise competing demands



Experience with HubSpot, AI tools, project management software or events is highly desirable.



Important



We are not looking for somebody who simply completes tasks.



We are looking for somebody who improves the business.



We value initiative, judgement and problem-solving far more than generic administrative experience.



Application Instructions



To apply, please answer the following questions:



1. Describe a process or system you improved without being asked.



2. Imagine you inherit a shared inbox containing 200 unread
s. What would your first three actions be?



3. What experience do you have with HubSpot, CRM systems or workflow automation?



4. What AI tools do you currently use in your work and how do you use them?



5. What do you believe would be the biggest challenge in this role?



6. Please record a 2-3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit.



7. Include the words "Nitrogen Ice Cream" at the start of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



Applications generated entirely by AI without personal examples will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Social Media Manager (Podcast & True Crime) Revaya
description:
Part-Time Social Media Manager (Podcast & True Crime)

Job Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern Time

Salary: $600



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a creative and strategic Part-Time Social Media Manager to manage and grow the social media presence of a leading investigative storytelling and true-crime podcast. This role is responsible for planning content, creating engaging social media assets, managing audience engagement, and supporting episode launches across multiple platforms.



The ideal candidate has experience with podcast marketing, social media content creation, and community management. They are passionate about storytelling, understand how to engage podcast audiences, and can transform audio and video content into compelling social media posts that drive conversation and audience growth.



Key Responsibilities:

Pre-Production & Content Planning

Develop and maintain a proactive social media content calendar aligned with upcoming podcast episodes and promotional campaigns.

Plan content in advance to ensure consistent posting and audience engagement.

Maintain an organized library of templates and creative assets to support efficient content production.

Attend monthly tea
etings and provide a social media perspective to episode planning and promotion strategies.



Content Production

Create engaging social media content, including quote graphics, short-form videos, and audiogram-style content using provided audio and video assets.

Write compelling captions that provide context, encourage discussion, and drive audience engagement.

Edit and produce social media videos from podcast recordings and other multimedia assets.

Maintain a consistent brand voice that resonates with podcast listeners and aligns with the show's storytelling style.



Post-Production & Community Engagement

Manage audience interactions across social media platforms by responding to comments and fostering meaningful conversations.

Monitor tags, mentions, and relevant industry conversations, and amplify audience- and guest-generated content when appropriate.

Coordinate with podcast guests following episode releases by sharing promotional assets and encouraging social media participation.

Support ongoing audience growth and community engagement initiatives through active social media management.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Proven experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing.

Experience managing social media accounts for podcasts, media brands, entertainment companies, or content-driven businesses is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of Instagram and other major social media platforms, including content trends, audience engagement, and platform best practices.

Familiarity with the podcast industry and a genuine interest in true crime, investigative storytelling, or long-form audio content.

Experience creating short-form video content, including reels, audiograms, and social clips from audio and video assets.

Proficiency with content creation and editing tools such as Canva, CapCut, Riverside, Descript, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar platforms.

Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with the ability to write engaging captions and audience-focused content.

Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to plan content and manage multiple deadlines independently.

Experience with community management, including responding to comments, monitoring engagement, and fostering audience interaction.

Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to maintain a consistent brand voice across all social media channels.

Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

title: Electrical and PCB Design Engineer
description:
T-Bird Drones is a stealth startup company that is pursuing the development of drone technologies.



An engineer is needed to support the design of printed circuit boards (PCB) and electrical systems on a drone.  The ideal candidate brings expertise in PCB layout, power electronics, signal integrity, EMI mitigation, and RF-aware design.  It is necessary to ensure robust electrical connectivity under vibration, thermal cycling, and environmental exposure typical of drone operation.



Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field

• Exceptional problem-solving skills

• Design of multi-layer PCBs for flight-critical and payload functions including motor control, power distribution, sensor fusion, and communication interfaces

• Develop schematics and PCB layouts using industry-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, KiCad, or Cadence)

• Perform design rule checks (DRC) and electrical rule checks (ERC) prior to fab release

• Define and manage stackup configurations for impedance control and high-speed signal routing

• Apply EMI best practices throughout PCB layout including ground plane strategy, decoupling, and trace routing to minimize radiated and conducted emissions

• Create and maintain component libraries, footprints, and design templates

• Ability to read and produce professional-quality schematics, PCB fabrication packages, and wiring documentation

• Good verbal and written communication skills in English



Preferred Qualifications:

• Advanced degree in engineering or related field

• BLDC motor system design

• Modeling and simulation



This position is an hourly job with deliverables every month.  Successful execution of milestone objectives in monthly deliverables will determine if continued work will be required from the job candidate.   The duration of this job can be long term with successful execution of milestones.  



This position is fully remote with flexible work times.  Occasional meetings in the Central Time Zone will be required.



Pay rate will be based on education, skills, and experience.

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

title: Mechanical Engineer – Firearms Trigger & Linkage Design (Fusion 360)
description:
About the Role:

We design precision firearm trigger mechanisms and are looking for a skilled mechanical engineer to develop forced reset trigger (FRT) systems and related mechanical assemblies. You'll work primarily in Fusion 360, modeling intricate linkages and multi-part assemblies that have to function reliably under real-world tolerances and forces.



Responsibilities:

Design and model forced reset triggers and fire-control components in Fusion 360

Build and constrain complex assemblies, validating motion and clearance through the linkage cycle

Develop mechanical linkages with proper kinematics for reliable reset and engagement

Apply design-for-manufacturability principles aimed at CNC machining (material selection, tolerances, fixturing, feature accessibility)

Produce manufacturing-ready drawings and documentation

Iterate designs based on prototype feedback and functional testing



Required Skills:

Strong proficiency in Fusion 360, especially assembly design, joints, and motion simulation

Solid grasp of mechanical linkage design and kinematics

Experience designing for CNC machining with realistic tolerances and DFM awareness

Ability to think through how parts move and interact, not just how they look

Clear written English for remote collaboration



Strongly Preferred:

Firearms experience, hobbyist gunsmithing, or genuine enthusiasm for firear
chanisms

Familiarity with fire-control group geometry and how triggers/sears/disconnectors interact

Background in small precision mechanisms or springs



To Apply:

Please share a portfolio or screenshots of Fusion 360 assemblies you've designed, ideally anything involving moving linkages or small mechanical mechanisms. Tell us briefly about your firearms interest or experience.

Pay

Test batch first. Volume scales up if quality and speed are good.



How to apply

contact me on Whatsapp +49 155 60950941 and send:

1. Short intro about you + your AI video experience

title: Media Buyer / Marketing Assistant — Become the Right Hand to a Founder Who's Spent $350M+ on Meta Ads

Not a 9–5. Not a side gig. A career-making seat for one sharp, hungry person.



I'm a founder based in Australia. I've personally managed over $350 million in Meta ad spend across e-commerce, lead gen, SaaS and info products. I run a performance marketing consultancy plus my own portfolio of brands — and I'm looking for my right hand.



This is not a normal job. It's an apprenticeship with real responsibility from day one.

THE HONEST PART — READ THIS TWICE:



This role is built around responsiveness, not fixed hours. You'll work mostly within Australian business hours (AEST). Some days you might have nothing between 11am and 3pm. But if something lands at 8pm that needs action, you jump on it. If that flexibility excites you, keep reading. If you want a rigid schedule and a clean log-off time, this isn't for you — no hard feelings.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU:



* Learn fast and pick things up naturally — I'd rather train a sharp beginner than untrain a mediocre "expert"

* Want a long-term seat. I'm hiring for years, not months

COMPENSATION:



We start at a fair rate while you learn the ropes. Prove yourself — speed, reliability, output — and you'll ramp quickly to well above market rate. I'd rather overpay one exceptional person than underpay three average ones. The better you get, the more you earn. I want this to be the last role you ever apply for.



HOW TO APPLY:



No generic templates. No CV blasts. Send me:



1. A 3-5 minute Loom video introducing yourself. Cover:

   - Who you are and what you're working on right now

   - Your experience (or honest proof you learn fast)

   - Your goals — where you want to be in 3 years

   - Why you think you'd be a good fit for THIS role specifically



2. Start your application with the word "VELOCITY" so I know you read this far



The Loom matters more than anything written. I'm hiring for sharpness, energy and communication — a video shows me all three in five minutes. Don't over-produce it. Just talk to me straight.



I watch every video personally. The right person will know this ad was written for them.

title: Outbound Cold Caller — $1,200/month + $50 per show-up appointment
description:
Why experienced setters join us



We created a role where your effort and results directly impact what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that is serious about helping you grow.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your work seriously, this is a place where you can build something long-term.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your income grows with your performance. The compensation structure is clear, the targets are realistic, and there is no limit to what you can earn each month.



02 — Leadership that helps you improve



You’ll work closely with a team that understands this business and knows what works. We share proven strategies, coach you on what needs improvement, and help you sharpen your skills — including tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard, but we also support each other in reaching it. You’ll be surrounded by people who are serious about their work, their performance, and their growth.



Compensation — paid weekly via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — paid on top of base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 appointments = 10%

Hit 16 appointments = 15%

Hit 20 appointments = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an additional ~$375/month. At Gold level, that can be an additional ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base salary and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00am – 5:30pm Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00pm – 6:30am Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role, and we want to be fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with the schedule, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We’ll walk you through the script, CRM, process, and call flow until you feel confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable goal, and we’ll be coaching you throughout the process to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify real needs and book qualified appointments with businesses that are ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script in a natural and conversational way — not robotic or mechanical.



Keep your pipeline, notes, and call logs updated accurately in the CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to strategies that have already proven to work.



Who we’re looking for



2+ years of experience in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.



A professional and natural phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not just a caller.



The ability to learn a script and deliver it as a real conversation.



A stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.



Comfort using a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.



What you’re walking into



You’re joining a company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously.



You’ll know exactly what is expected, exactly how you get paid, and exactly how you can grow.



We’re looking for people who want to stay, improve, and build with us long term.



Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.
